fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/api/archetypes2` controller (`archetypes2_api`) contained a per-archetype loop that computed `key_cards`, `num_matches`, and `colors_safe` inline before delegating to `prepare_archetypes`. This business logic belonged in the prepare layer alongside the rest of the archetype decoration, not in the controller.

## What changed

- **`decksite/prepare.py`**: Extended `prepare_archetype` and `prepare_archetypes` with two optional parameters, `archetype_key_cards: dict | None = None` and `cards: dict | None = None`. When both are provided, `prepare_archetype` now computes `key_cards`, `num_matches`, and `colors_safe` for the archetype. Moved `is_uninteresting` helper here from `api.py`. Added the required `image_fetcher` and `find_colors` imports.
- **`decksite/controllers/api.py`**: Removed the 8-line per-archetype loop; the controller now precomputes `archetype_key_cards` and `cards` once and passes them directly to `prepare_archetypes`. Removed now-unused imports (`image_fetcher`, `find_colors`, `Card`, `colors_html`) and the `is_uninteresting` local function.

All existing callers of `prepare_archetypes` / `prepare_archetype` that don't pass the new optional params are unaffected (the params default to `None`).

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (no errors)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped (environmental skip unrelated to this change)

Fixes #12590
